overview: This Senate resolution allows senators and Senate staff to collect donated clothing, toys, food and household goods from one another in Senate buildings during the holiday season, which Senate rules would otherwise restrict. The donations must go to charitable causes serving people in need or members of the military and their families, and Senate staff may work with nonprofit groups to deliver them. Cash donations are not covered. The permission expires at the end of the first session of the 119th Congress. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on November 10, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution lets Senate offices run simple holiday donation drives to help people in need and military families.
against: Critics say the resolution is a narrow internal matter that does not change any law or public spending.
